About Location: Lot G3, Que Vo Industrial Park (expanded area), Nam Son Ward, Bac Ninh City, Vietnam
About Intro Summary: Almus Tech Co., Ltd. is a strategic partner (vendor) specializing in manufacturing and assembling electronic components, especially headsets and components for mobile devices, smartwatches. It is 100% Korean-invested, operating in Bac Ninh and a main supplier for Samsung.
About History Phase 1 Detail: Focused on building factories, production facilities, and investing in high-tech machinery lines. Recruited a team of engineers to operate precise metal component production.
About History Phase 2 Detail: Expanded scale and enhanced technology. Applied advanced quality management systems to meet international partner standards. Major contributor to the regional supply chain.
About Activity QC Detail: Strict quality control regarding product appearance, technical specifications, and durability.
About Activity Finish Detail: Finished according to the highest quality standards of the enterprise and customers.
About Reg Time Detail: Working administrative hours (08:00-17:00) and production shifts (Day/Night). Complete fingerprint/card timekeeping.
About Reg Discipline Detail: Compliance with labor rules and 5S. Strictly prohibited from bringing sharp objects or flammable substances into the workshop.
About Reg 5S Detail: Sort – Set In Order – Shine – Standardize – Sustain
About Security QC Importance: Inspection data and evaluation results are critical assets, ensuring the company's reputation and transparency.
About Security QC Measures: Access control, measurement equipment security, periodic backups, and immediate access revocation upon resignation.
About Intern Content: Understand the real-world environment, production processes, and quality inspection of high-tech components (Buds, Watch, Cradle).
About Intern Goal 1: Understand the actual working environment at the enterprise
About Intern Goal 2: Grasp production processes and quality control
About Intern Week 1: Join department, understand structure, and start following requirements.
About Intern Week 2: Comply with regulations, familiarize with culture, and perform professional tasks.
About Intern Week 3: Exchange professional knowledge, identify product defects, and finalize internship content.
About Reg 5S Detail: Sort • Set in Order • Shine • Standardize • Sustain
About OQC Step 1 Desc: Receive batches from production, verify quantities, and prepare finger cots/protection.
About OQC Step 2 Desc: Inspect surfaces under strong light for scratches, cracks, or glue residue.
About OQC Step 3 Desc: Check Upper and Lower shells, ensuring logos and LEDs are correctly aligned.
About OQC Step 4 Desc: Separate Pass products into trays and NG (No Good) products into disposal areas.
About OQC Step 5 Desc: Update yield and defect data in the system and the KPI daily report.
About QC Pass Item 1: Flat surface, no scratches, no cracks.
About QC Pass Item 2: Uniform color, clear logo, correct positioning.
About QC Fail Item 1: Cracks, chips, or warping (even microscopic ones).
About QC Fail Item 2: LED Defects: Misalignment, uneven brightness, or non-functional.
About QC Fail Item 3: Upper/Lower Defects: Uneven gaps, misaligned joints, or looseness.
About QC Fail Item 4: Scratches: Surface scratches on glossy areas, glue residue, or particles.
About QC Fail Item 5: Logo Errors: Blurred, smudged, incorrect orientation, or ink marks.
